decisions.briefing: Market data was unavailable today and conditions read neutral (NASDAQ/S&P +0.0%), so there's no genuine risk-on signal to act on. Cash on hand ($89.29) is well below the $500 deployment threshold anyway, so no new buys are being forced — holding all 7 existing positions and letting stop-loss/profit-target rules handle exits automatically.

market_education.summary_en: No reliable market data or news feed was available for today's session, so index moves are showing as flat (+0.0%) placeholders rather than real price action. Without confirmed data, it's safer to assume a neutral, uneventful session than to infer a trend that isn't there. Trading decisions today are therefore driven by portfolio state (low cash) rather than market signals.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日未能取得可靠嘅市場數據或新聞來源，所以指數變動顯示為持平（+0.0%）嘅佔位數字，並非真實價格走勢。喺數據未能確認嘅情況下，假設市況中性、平淡會比胡亂推測趨勢更穩妥。因此今日嘅交易決定主要係基於投資組合狀況（現金偏低），而非市場訊號。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-Off describes a defensive posture where an investor avoids adding new positions, typically because there's not enough conviction, data, or capital to justify the risk. Today that meant holding cash and existing holdings steady rather than forcing a trade just to stay active.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「Risk-Off」（避險模式）指投資者採取防守性策略，避免新增持倉，通常係因為信心、數據或資金不足以支持風險。今日就係將現金同現有持倉維持不變，唔會為咗「有交易」而勉強落單。
